title: Project Schema
description: Schema for defining remora project configuration

version.description: Version of the project in semver format

consumers.description: DEPRECATED and ignored. Resource folders are fixed: /sources, /producers, /consumers, /schemas and /code_sets. Remove this property

producers.description: DEPRECATED and ignored. Resource folders are fixed: /sources, /producers, /consumers, /schemas and /code_sets. Remove this property

sources.description: DEPRECATED and ignored. Resource folders are fixed: /sources, /producers, /consumers, /schemas and /code_sets. Remove this property

schemas.description: DEPRECATED and ignored. Resource folders are fixed: /sources, /producers, /consumers, /schemas and /code_sets. Remove this property

codeSets.description: DEPRECATED and ignored. Resource folders are fixed: /sources, /producers, /consumers, /schemas and /code_sets. Remove this property

SQL_MAX_QUERY_ROWS.description: Maximum number of rows for SQL queries

source.description: Name of an aws-sqs source used as an alternative execute-consumer API

deadLetterQueue.description: Dead-letter queue URL, or queue name resolved against the API queue's region and accountId. A command that failed is moved here instead of being deleted, so it can be inspected and replayed. A command always leaves the queue once it has run, successfully or not, so there is no delivery count to bound here

MAX_ITEMS_IN_MEMORY.description: Maximum number of items to keep in memory
